# Midday alert, Tue Oct 20, 2026 (Research Inc., ~12:30 PM ET)

**Unconfirmed US-Iran peace proposal flips oil and stocks; partly walked back.**

- Qatar-Pakistan compromise report (unconfirmed) sank Brent ~3% to ~$106 from a ~$112 high; WTI Dec ~$96. ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/unconfirmed-qatarpakistan-iran-peace-proposal-lifts-stocks-weighs-on-oil-4960631), [AA](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/economy/brent-falls-3-as-oil-prices-reverse-earlier-rally-towards-112/4094843), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/20/oil-price-wti-brent-crude.html))
- Dow +518 (1%), S&P +0.4%, Nasdaq +0.2% at 11:45 AM. ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stock-markets-oil-ai-rates-inflation-b972b64127db5412a2b02c35ecf95c88))
- A diplomat says a deal isn't close; oil and stocks gave some back. ([investingLive](https://investinglive.com/commodities/iran-and-us-talks-continue-reports-that-a-deal-is-close-are-wrong/))

**Desk read (long-only swing):** Tickers: HAL, XOM, airlines (DAL, UAL, AAL, LUV, ALK, JETS), SPY. Don't add to HAL; oil premium is headline-driven (lesson 10/09). Keep airline avoids: the proposal is unconfirmed and UAL reports tonight. No signals.json change.
